test_title: PYST 71: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Rihan starts from Point A and drives 24 km towards East. He then takes a right turn, drives 50 km, turns right and drives 51 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 63 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 27 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
**Given:**

Rihan starts from Point A and drives:

→ 24 km towards East

→ Turns right and drives 50 km

→ Turns right and drives 51 km

→ Turns right and drives 63 km

→ Turns right and drives 27 km to reach Point P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4a88fb2a8333683be52f57846889115ff99a6bfbffaf1e060859a216f85fcb2.png] 

To reach Point A again, Rihan must travel **13 km towards South**.

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".**
